message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout right when I was about to start dinner. I quickly grabbed my trusty power bank and charged up my phone, which meant I could still play some music and keep the mood light. I even found my little lantern from camping trips, and it turned our kitchen into a cozy glow! It’s amazing how a few small things can turn a little hiccup into a fun family moment. What’s one small win you’ve had during a power outage?
